topic: Mobile combo HUD overlap and startup loading polish
currentUserGoal: Fix the combo badge overlapping behind the mobile HUD first, then begin mobile optimization for laggy moments and the green startup screen.
workCompleted: Moved the mobile combo badge so its ornate frame starts below the resource HUD instead of overlapping the Auto chip row.
Kept the combo badge position fresh while hidden and relayouted the header plus queued a UI board layout only when combo badge visibility changes.
Added an immediate HTML loading shell in `index.html` so mobile users see a branded loading state before JavaScript and Phaser finish booting.
Added `window.__grassAppReady` and boot timing dataset fields in `src/main.ts`; TitleScene and GameScene mark the app ready after their first usable UI is built.
Added a small GameScene preload progress label so continuing into gameplay does not show an empty green canvas while gameplay assets load.
Trimmed TitleScene first-paint asset loading by loading only the current-orientation title background up front, then lazy-loading the alternate background after the title renders.
Deferred class picker icon loading and hidden class picker construction until after the title appears, with a safe loading notice if Start is tapped before the picker is ready.
Reduced mobile browser-chrome resize churn by ignoring 2px viewport height jitter, throttling resize application to 120ms, and removing the visualViewport scroll resize listener.
verification: `npm run build` passed after the combo fix.
`npm run build` passed again after startup/loading and resize changes.
Local mobile viewport 390x844 visual check at `http://127.0.0.1:5173/?stress&mobileTest=audio&tiles=1200`: combo badge rendered below the HUD and above the quest nudge after rapid taps.
Local mobile title check at `http://127.0.0.1:5173/?v=startup-check-1`: title rendered normally, loading shell removed, `document.documentElement.dataset.grassBootReadyMs` reported 357ms locally.
Local mobile class picker check: tapping Start opened the picker with class icons loaded and readable.

Post-change browser perf harness at `http://127.0.0.1:5173/?perfHarness&tiles=1200&v=post-startup-opt` completed with visibleTiles 12-15, layoutPasses 0, redraws 0, redrawQueued 0, maxFrameDeltaMs 7-10, frameSpikes 0, displayObjects 170-192, activeTweens 13-22, and hotspots ending at `hot none`.
knownIssues: The harness did not reproduce the tester's intermittent real-phone lag; the resize-churn change is a targeted mitigation for mobile browser chrome changes, not a proven full fix for every lag report.
GameScene still eagerly preloads skill, item, tile, world, and effect assets before gameplay starts. Further startup reductions should profile asset timing before moving more panels to lazy creation.
The local dev server was started on `http://127.0.0.1:5173/` for browser checks.
nextRecommendedSteps: Run a real iPhone/Android playtest focused on browser toolbar show/hide, returning from background, opening Skills/Store, and rapid tapping after the resize-throttle change.

If startup is still slow on a phone, capture mobile network/resource timing and consider lazy-creating closed gameplay panels such as Skill Tree, Quest Log, Store, Journal, and Automation after the board first renders.
Commit and push the intended tracked changes once the user is happy with this slice.
doNotRevert: Keep combo badge visibility changes tied to a UI board layout request; ordinary combo meter refreshes should not trigger repeated board layouts.
Keep the loading shell ready marker in both TitleScene and GameScene because stress/mobile-test/title-bypass routes need GameScene to hide the shell.
Leave unrelated untracked docs, artifacts, audio files, and the older untracked handoff untouched.
